guide.title: Guide
guide.heading: How to lend equipment
guide.intro: A booking promises units for a window; the hand-out and the return are the two scans around it.

book.title: Book
book.body: New booking: choose who is taking it, the pickup and return, then a model with a count or a specific unit. The sheet refuses a line that does not fit and offers fewer units or the nearest free window.

handOut.title: Hand out
handOut.body: On the day, open the booking and scan every unit (or choose it). A scan of a matching model fills an "any unit" line. The hand-out is confirmed only when every line is covered.

takeBack.title: Take it back
takeBack.body: Record each unit's condition. "Needs service" asks what happened and until when, and blocks the unit for that time; if a later booking would lose its unit, the screen offers to move it, or to end the block before it.

late.title: Watch what is late
late.body: Today lists the day's pickups and returns and every loan past its window. Late is derived from the window; there is no status to keep in step.

kits.title: Kits
kits.body: A kit is a named set of units and models. Book it as one line; its availability comes from its members, so it is unavailable when any member is. Scan the kit's code at the hand-out and the whole set goes out at once.

borrower.title: Borrowers without an account
borrower.body: A booking can name a partner, a member, or somebody outside the system with a name and an e-mail. A partner's page shows their past and upcoming rentals, and an asset's timeline shows the bookings it was part of.

rules.buffer: Buffer hours around a booking belong to the model or its category and make the unit unbookable inside them.
rules.block: A manual or service block cannot cover an existing booking, and a booking cannot be made into a block.
rules.overdue: Overdue is read from the window and the status, never stored; extending moves the expected return of the hand-out too.
rules.partial: A booking can come back in parts: the units still out keep it handed out and late, and the units that came back are free at once.
rules.kits: A kit cannot be booked while any of its members is busy, and a kit is handed out or returned as the whole set.
rules.reminders: The borrower is reminded by e-mail before the window ends, and once a day while the booking is late, on the organization's own clock.
rules.bookAgain: 'Book again' copies a finished booking's borrower and lines into a new draft with new dates; nothing is saved until you press Book.
